### Connection Analyzer does not use a documented ARM base resource type

### Connection Analyzer does not use the documented ARM resource operation templates

- **Severity:** medium
- **Summary:** The new resource-style CRUD and list operations use legacy action helpers and manual routes instead of standard ARM resource-operation templates.
